status: pre-registered: P1a, P1c, P1d held; P1b failed; re-test (seed 1) replicated
text: Inhibitor neurons exist for every concept tested: knocking out a neuron with negative attribution raises the held-out answer (Qwen3-0.6B)
detail: 40 run-1 concepts within 0.6B's reach; neurons chosen on half the prompts, measured on the other half. 645 of 800 bottom-attribution neurons raise the answer beyond the null's 99th percentile (+0.049); 40/40 concepts have one; median best +0.73 log-odds (best helper -1.58). Spread over all layers. A few are shared dampeners (L17:1763 in 23/40, L11:1708 in 22/40, L14:941 in 20/40). Removing one lowers the top rival in 91%: format rivals ('The', lower case) and content rivals ('Reflection' for 'Refraction'). Re-test (seed 1, 20 concepts, 8 not in the first run): 20/20 have inhibitors, median best +0.75; on the 8 new concepts 8/8, 133 of 160 bottom neurons pass, median best +0.65; the same shared dampeners recur.
evidence_sql: SELECT * FROM evidence WHERE experiment_id IN ('mech_inhibitors_06b', 'mech_inhibitors_06b_retest') AND context LIKE 'selection=bottom_attr;half=B%'
docs: MECHANISMS.md#H1. Inhibitor neurons - HELD (the strongest new category)

status: pre-registered: P4a held, P4b failed, P4c held for 4 of 5 languages
text: Language-identity neurons sit late (median layer 21-25 of 28) and are needed for their own language only; English needs none (Qwen3-0.6B)
detail: 40 content-matched sentences in en/fr/de/es/zh; held-out AUC >= 0.95: en 71, fr 37, de 146, es 44, zh 275 neurons. Zeroing a language's top 20 raises its own loss (fr +0.45, de +0.71, es +0.28, zh +0.08 nats/token) and barely any other's; random sets <= 0.05. Zeroing the English set does nothing (-0.001).
docs: MECHANISMS.md#H4. Language-identity neurons - HELD (late, not early)

status: pre-registered: P3a, P3b held; P3c failed; exploratory K=200 follow-up: damage not copying-specific
text: Many neurons register that text repeats (median layer 15), but copying does not depend on them (Qwen3-0.6B)
detail: 3,688 neurons fire more and 3,844 less on a repeated random-token sequence than on a matched non-repeat (held-out d >= 2). Zeroing the top 20 raises second-copy loss by 0.015 nats (random -0.0004); the top 200 by 0.099 (random 0.011) but the no-repeat control rises as much (0.116).
evidence_sql: SELECT * FROM evidence WHERE experiment_id IN ('mech_repeat_06b', 'mech_repeat_06b_k200') AND evidence_type = 'group_knockout'

status: pre-registered v1 failed; exploratory v2 found one neuron (L27:47)
text: No confidence (entropy) neurons by the pre-registered weights rule; an exploratory rule finds one, L27:47 (Qwen3-0.6B)
detail: v1: no neuron of 50 changed output entropy by more than 0.019 nats; 0.6B's tied unembedding has no real null space (smallest singular value 3.6 vs median 10.3). v2 (rule chosen after v1): L27:47 changes entropy by 0.104 nats (17x the random 95th percentile), 2.4x its direct effect, top word kept 98%.
evidence_sql: SELECT * FROM evidence WHERE experiment_id IN ('mech_entropy_06b', 'mech_entropy_06b_v2')
